title: Provider connections
description: Save a connection once; all its models share the address and key. Cloud models remain independent.
chooseDescription: Choose an existing file to manage local Provider models. This replaces the active file binding, not cloud models or independent legacy configurations.
fileHint: The page and YAML edit the same configuration. Save externally, then reload. Invalid files retain the last valid configuration.
migrateDescription: Move {{count}} existing local models into shared connections, grouping only identical addresses, keys, protocols and paths. Model IDs and capabilities are preserved. Cloud models are not changed.
deleteDescription: Remove “{{name}}” and its {{count}} models from new selections? Existing conversations are not deleted. No other provider or cloud model is changed.
emptyModels: No models yet. Edit this connection to add models.
empty: Add a Provider or bind an existing model.yml file.
name: Connection name
discoveryHint: Save the connection before retrieving models. Discovery does not test inference or tool support. Manual entry is always available.
batch: Paste model IDs (one per line or comma-separated)
saveHint: Saving writes the bound YAML file; keys entered here use the local encrypted credential store. New catalog entries are reconciled when the runtime is idle. Active tasks are not forcibly restarted.
discardDescription: Unsaved connection and model changes will be lost.
